answer: The verifier hands the author a fresh seed and orders it to reproduce its graded reasoning from scratch under a new spiral prompt variant, reaching the same conclusion. Each step is checked against the original answer, and any deviation ends the round. One honest agent re-derives one answer in about 15 minutes; ten fakes must re-derive ten answers in parallel, ten times the compute and the time. A failed re-derivation fails verification, the bond is slashed, and the pearl author stays frozen until a pigment recheck clears it.
